full_judgment: 28. Mr. Aminul Huq submits that Ramna Police Station being a citadel of the Police, no outsiders having any entry there, what actually happened to Arun, nobody could know. Prosecution has taken all possible endeavours to get the news. PW 5, PW 6, PW 8 and Abu Miah, father of deceased Arun went to Ramna Police Station, PW 6 heard sound of screaming coming out of Ramna Police Station. PW 8 saw that Arun was being lifted and carried by two persons to Police vehicle. Abu Miah saw that the accused-appellants were beating Arun. So prosecution did all that was possible. The accused Police were there in actual control of the Police station. They took bribe by extortion. The Police officers had guilty minds or mensrea. Therefore, the natural presumption as to the cause of injuries as revealed through the post-mortem report would adversely fall upon the accused-appellants. It is the accused-appellants alone who had caused the injuries on the person of Arun and they arc guilty of the offence charged under section 304, Part 11/34 Penal Code. Because the cause of injuries is peculiarly within the knowledge of the accused alone who had absolute control over the Ramna Police Station and the victim Arun was in their absolute custody.
